basis:
Independent arithmetic: pain run 1 + rest/walk 2 + swelling 2 + volume >10% 1 + sleep <7 h 1 = 7. Band high at 5 or above. redFlags true because painAtRestOrWalking and swelling are both true.

Steps: ["Pain during running: 1 point.", "Pain at rest or while walking: 2 points; swelling: 2 points; either true sets redFlags = true.", "Night or morning pain: false, 0 points.", "Volume change 15% is above +10%: 1 point; sleep 5.5 h is below 7 h: 1 point; prior injury: false, 0 points.", "Total = 1 + 2 + 2 + 0 + 1 + 1 + 0 = 7, which is 5 or above, so band is high."]
Notes: The red flag (rest/walking pain or swelling) outranks the total score: stop running and seek professional assessment. This case gives no individualized exercise prescription; rehabilitation and return-to-run decisions follow clinical assessment, not the checklist.
